items.headline: Federal Reserve Raises Benchmark Interest Rate to Target Range of 3.75% to 4.00%
items.summary: The United States Federal Reserve voted unanimously to increase its benchmark interest rate by a quarter of a percentage point, bringing the target range to 3.75 to 4.00 percent. Central bank officials stated that the policy move was necessary to curb elevated inflation, marking the Fed's first interest rate hike in three years.

items.headline: Canada and Germany Commit $300 Million to AI Safety Research
items.summary: At the ALL IN 2026 conference in Montreal, Canada and Germany announced a joint funding package of up to $300 million for LawZero, a non-profit AI safety organization led by computer scientist Yoshua Bengio. The investment aims to develop trustworthy artificial intelligence systems with transparent safety measures built directly into their design.

items.headline: Raphinha Hat Trick Powers Barcelona Win as Brighton Upsets Manchester United
items.summary: On September 16, Brazilian forward Raphinha scored a hat trick to lead Barcelona to a 7-2 victory over Racing Santander in La Liga. On the same day, Manchester United was eliminated from the English League Cup after suffering a 3-2 upset against Brighton.

items.headline: Emmys in Advanced Talks to Move Telecast to Amazon Prime Video
items.summary: The Television Academy is in advanced talks to move the annual Emmy Awards telecast to Amazon Prime Video following the expiration of its multi-network broadcast agreement. If finalized, the landmark deal would shift television's biggest night off traditional broadcast networks for the first time since the show began in 1949.
